_: Which pack each vanilla biome of the layout is generated from. 'order': the first provider in this list that ships the biome for 26.3 wins ('vanilla' always has it), so a newer Overrealm that covers more biomes takes them over from Geophilic by itself. 'biomes': exceptions, e.g. {"minecraft:taiga": "vanilla"}. 'drop_features': placed features (fnmatch patterns) taken out of the provider biomes because they cannot work on the islands. See README.md, 'Biome packs'.
